units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:2:9">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᶜ</cite> top <he>אויר חוֹרְבָּתוֹ</he> (if one sells) the space filled with debris belonging to him.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:2:9">Ib.</cite> <he>תלוש מן הח׳ וכ׳</he> break some stones from this ruin by which thou mayest take possession of the space; a. fr. [<cite ref="Arakhin 12a">Arakh. 12ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00454"><he>חוּרְבָּא</he> I</cite>.]—Pl. <he>חוֹרָבוֹת</he>, <cite ref="H01675"><he>חֳרָבוֹת</he></cite>. Ber. l. c. <he>חורבה אחת מחוֹרְבוֹת וכ׳</he> one of the ruins of Jerusalem.
